set.body: Create R/smoothness.R with constructors smoothness_fwhm(fwhm_mm) and smoothness_acf(a, b, c). Both return objects with class=neurothresh_smoothness. Add validators. RFT methods accept only smoothness_fwhm; MC null factories accept either. Drop fwhm_vox/fwhm_mm/acf_params as top-level args from public API. See specs/api-consistency-plan.md §3.
set.title: [apicon] Phase 2: smoothness class
